title: Project Pivot: Rumors that UnitedHealth Group Will Fire CEO Surface
subtitle: Breaking rumors...is that the same as news?
text:
The Frontier Psychiatrists’ editor—Owen Scott Muir, M.D., DFAACAP, also has a TikTok account. That user name is "iamafraidourtimeisup.” This started as a way to be a little silly. It has become how those stricken by discontent at Optum/UHC find a journalist who will tell their story. Much to my surprise, that person is me.

Share

Today, there is more breaking news. There are rumors within Optum that a pivot is needed. They call this program, with all the creativity of a corporate leviathan, “project pivot.” They need to keep up with the changing Medicare Advantage landscape. There is the fallout from the Change Cyber Attack…and subsequent DOJ investigations. Here is what we have from lightly confirmed sources, Sir—yes, he’s a literal knight—Andrew Witty is already fired, and I’m reporting this breaking story, per my source:
